Handles scenes with 100M or 1G+ splats via a default 16M-splat GPU memory pool
Adds a .RAD streamable LoD format for HTTP Range-request loading and a SparkXr WebXR wrapper with hand tracking
quotes: can traverse the tree in O(N log N) time
100 M or 1 G+ splats

sources.title: PlayCanvas Open Sources SOG: The WebP of Gaussian Splatting
key_claims: SOG stores splat data as WebP images in Morton order for GPU-ready decoding without post-load processing
A showcase scene compresses 1GB of PLY data (4M gaussians) down to 42MB, a ~95% reduction, roughly 2-3x better than compressed PLY
Engine support landed in PlayCanvas Engine 2.11.0; spec and reference implementation are open-sourced
quotes: The WebP of Gaussian Splatting

sources.title: splat-transform README
key_claims: Reads PLY, Compressed PLY, SOG, Streamed SOG, SPZ, SPLAT, KSPLAT, LCC, LCC2; writes PLY, Compressed PLY, SOG, Streamed SOG, SPZ, GLB, CSV, HTML Viewer, LOD, Voxel, WebP
Supports Morton reordering, NaN/Inf stripping, box/sphere/harmonic-band/floater filters, and sparse voxel octree generation for collision
Installable via npm as @playcanvas/splat-transform, or usable browser-side via WebAssembly at superspl.at/convert

sources.title: SPZ 4 is here: leaner, faster, and more future-proof
key_claims: SPZ 4 compresses ~3-5x faster and loads ~1.5-2.1x faster than SPZ3, e.g. 1min8s vs 3min26s encoding a 34M-point dataset
Replaces the single GZip stream with six parallel ZSTD streams for multi-core compression, removes the old 10M-point cap, and raises SH support to degree 4 with configurable 3/5/8-bit quantization
Files remain roughly 10x smaller than uncompressed PLY
quotes: SPZ 4 compresses about 3-5x faster, loads roughly 1.5-2x faster end-to-end

sources.title: Babylon.js V9.0: 3DGS Gets Shadows, SOGs, and Triangle Splatting Support Announced
key_claims: Babylon.js v9.0 (March 26, 2026) adds shadow-casting for Gaussian splat meshes and native loading of the SOG/SOGS format from Fraunhofer HHI
Adds experimental 'Triangle Splatting' (Univ. of Liège/UCLouvain technique) replacing gaussian ellipsoids with opaque triangles for sort-free depth-correct rendering
Unifies loading of .splat, .ply, .spz, and .sog through one pipeline; adds orthographic-camera support for splats

sources.title: SuperSplat 2.0 lets you create flythroughs of 3D Gaussian Splats

Ratification expected Q2 2026; contributors include Autodesk, Bentley Systems/Cesium, Esri, Huawei, Niantic Spatial, NVIDIA, and XGRIDS
Design allows graceful fallback to point-cloud rendering in viewers lacking splat support

sources.title: SparkRenderer docs - Spark
key_claims: SparkRenderer requires a THREE.WebGLRenderer (WebGL2) instance and disables antialiasing since it doesn't help splat rendering; no WebGPU path documented
Offers radial vs Z-depth splat sorting and configurable target splat counts: ~500K-750K for WebXR, 1-1.5M mobile, 2.5M desktop via lodSplatScale

sources.title: facebookresearch/vggt (README, LICENSE)
key_claims: VGGT is a feed-forward transformer inferring camera poses, depth maps, point maps and 3D point tracks from one, a few, or hundreds of views within seconds
Base VGGT-1B checkpoint is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial); a separate VGGT-1B-Commercial checkpoint released 2025-07-29 permits commercial use excluding military applications
A 2026-05 update lets VGGT run on roughly 2-3x more input frames at the same GPU memory budget after a memory fix
VGGT provides a script exporting predictions to COLMAP format, usable downstream with gsplat/Brush
No native panorama/equirectangular ingestion is documented
quotes: a non-exclusive, worldwide, non-transferable and royalty-free limited license

sources.title: VGGT-Omega project page / facebookresearch/vggt-omega
key_claims: VGGT-Omega is a CVPR 2026 Oral successor to VGGT, using ~30% of VGGT's training memory and running 1.6x faster at inference
Trained with 20x more supervised data and 100x more unsupervised data than prior work via a new dynamic-scene annotation pipeline and self-supervised protocol
Improves camera estimation accuracy by 77% on Sintel versus prior best
Checkpoints are gated (request access required); a Hugging Face demo is public

sources.title: π³ (Pi3): Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning (arXiv + yyfz/Pi3)
key_claims: Pi3 is fully permutation-equivariant: it predicts affine-invariant poses and scale-invariant point maps without any fixed reference view, robust to input ordering
Accepts unordered images, video, or static/dynamic scenes
Inference speed: 57.4 FPS vs VGGT 43.2 FPS vs DUSt3R 1.25 FPS
Code (yyfz/Pi3) is BSD-3-Clause; model weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial only)
Pi3X upgrade released 2025-12-28 adds smoother point clouds, optional pose/intrinsics/depth conditioning, and approximate metric scale
Accepted at ICLR 2026 (last revised 2026-03-07); outputs points/local_points/conf/camera_poses only -- no direct Gaussian splat output

sources.title: MapAnything: Universal Feed-Forward Metric 3D Reconstruction (facebookresearch/map-anything)
key_claims: Developed by Meta Reality Labs and CMU; end-to-end transformer regressing factored metric 3D geometry from images with optional poses/intrinsics/depth
Code is Apache-2.0; two checkpoint variants exist -- 'facebook/map-anything' (CC-BY-NC-4.0) and 'facebook/map-anything-apache' (Apache-2.0, fully permissive)
Supports over 12 reconstruction tasks (SfM, MVS, camera localization, depth completion) and wraps VGGT, DUSt3R, MASt3R, MUSt3R, Pi3-X interchangeably behind one interface
Memory-efficient mode processes up to 2000 views on 140GB GPU memory
Exported COLMAP-format files can be used directly with gsplat for Gaussian Splatting training
Latest release v1.1.3 dated 2026-07-17; no native panorama/equirectangular ingestion documented
quotes: the exported COLMAP files can be directly used with gsplat for Gaussian Splatting training

sources.title: AnySplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Views
key_claims: SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 (ACM TOG) paper; single feed-forward pass predicts 3D Gaussian primitives plus camera intrinsics/extrinsics directly from uncalibrated images -- no COLMAP or poses required
Trained without 3D SfM or MVS supervision, relying solely on uncalibrated images
License is MIT (fully permissive)
Processes standard perspective images (448x448); no panorama/equirectangular support documented
Renders novel views within seconds of inference

sources.title: Depth Anything 3 (ByteDance-Seed/Depth-Anything-3)
key_claims: Handles single-image and multi-view input; predicts spatially consistent geometry with or without known camera poses
Outputs include camera extrinsics/intrinsics in COLMAP-style format plus a '3D Gaussian prediction' capability, similar in scope to VGGT
DA3-BASE/SMALL/METRIC-LARGE/MONO-LARGE are Apache-2.0; the recommended '-1.1' Giant/Large/Nested variants are CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research only)
DA3-Streaming supports long video sequences under 12GB GPU memory via sliding window
PyPI package (depth-anything-3) published 2026-03-04; claims to outperform VGGT on multi-view depth and pose estimation
No panorama/360 support documented; perspective imagery only

sources.title: SPAG-4D: 360° Panorama to 3D Gaussian Splats (cedarconnor/SPAG4d)
key_claims: Converts a single equirectangular panorama into a 3D Gaussian splat PLY using one of four backends (DA360, DAP, PaGeR, SHARP 360); no camera poses or SfM required
Single-image only -- no multi-view/multi-panorama fusion across a photo set
VRAM needs 6-48GB depending on backend and optional refinement
Core license is MIT; DA360/DAP MIT; SHARP/PaGeR are research/non-commercial; optional OmniRoam refinement uses an Adobe Research License
Optional ArtiFixer3D path bridges internally to COLMAP for novel-view consistency but is not exposed to the user
Portable release 2026-02-21; ~215 GitHub stars, ~247 commits at time of check

sources.title: PanoVGGT: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Panoramic Imagery
key_claims: Takes an unordered set of 2-24 equirectangular panoramas (512x1024) and predicts camera poses, dense depth maps, and 3D point clouds in world/camera coordinates in one feed-forward pass
Uses a DINOv2 ViT-B/14 encoder with spherical-aware positional embeddings and a 24-block alternating-attention Geometry Aggregator
On the outdoor PanoCity dataset: pose AUC@30 = 0.949, median translation error 0.873 degrees, depth Abs Rel 0.0196, described as robust across diverse urban scenes and weather
Accepted at CVPR 2026; paper states 'Code and dataset will be released' but availability was not confirmed as of this check
quotes: Code and dataset will be released

sources.title: Global Structure-from-Motion Meets Feedforward Reconstruction (GLUEMAP)
key_claims: Authored by Linfei Pan, Johannes Schönberger (COLMAP's original author), and Marc Pollefeys; accepted CVPR 2026
Proposes a hybrid SfM pipeline combining classical global SfM with feed-forward models specifically to overcome COLMAP failure modes: low texture, limited overlap, and symmetric scenes
Implementation (colmap/gluemap) vendors Pi3, SALAD, a VGGSfM tracker, and Doppelgangers++ as feed-forward components alongside a C++/Ceres/Eigen backend
Signals that even COLMAP's own authors treat feed-forward models as complementary patches for classical SfM's weak spots rather than a full replacement at scale

sources.title: DUSt3R / MASt3R license and MASt3R-SfM scalability
key_claims: DUSt3R and MASt3R remain licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike) as of this check, restricting use in a permissively-licensed open pipeline without separate permission from Naver
MASt3R-SfM extends MASt3R with a frozen-encoder retrieval step, achieving quasi-linear complexity in image count versus MASt3R's pairwise-only scaling

PanoSplatt3R (arXiv 2507.21960, 2025-07) adapts MASt3R/DUSt3R perspective pretraining via transfer learning for wide-baseline panorama reconstruction, showing the lineage is being extended toward panoramic inputs

sources.title: Gaussian Splatting from 360 Video: From Insta360 Capture to 3D (Mikhail Mokrushin)
key_claims: Recommends exporting equirectangular from Insta360 Studio, extracting keyframes every 1-2 seconds, then converting each 360 image into 6 cubemap faces with ~10% overlap and exporting in COLMAP format.
Compares local training (Nerfstudio, Brush, Postshot -- max control, needs powerful GPU) vs cloud semi-automatic (Teleport/Polycam/KIRI, frame-limited) vs fully automatic (Splatica).
States current splatting algorithms cannot ingest raw 360/fisheye footage directly, so preprocessing is mandatory.
quotes: Gaussian Splatting creation algorithms currently don't know how to work with raw 360 video or fisheye lens footage.

sources.title: Using 360 Video for 3D Gaussian Splatting (and NeRFs) - Jonathan Stephens (LinkedIn post)
key_claims: Demonstrates splitting 360 images horizontally into standard 2D perspective slices because COLMAP does not natively handle spherical/cylindrical projections.
Author frames this as 'the easiest but not the best way,' implying better methods exist.
A commenter reported a COLMAP run taking 1008 minutes and producing a 30GB database.db with no output, illustrating processing-scale pitfalls.
quotes: the EASIEST but not the BEST way
after 1008 minutes i have 30 gb of database.db and no output

sources.title: I Built My Own Tools to Turn 360 Footage Into Clean Gaussian Splatting Data (realitystack Substack)
key_claims: Built '3DGaussianTools': extracts frames (every-N or target fps), scores sharpness via Laplacian variance, and selects frames by best-n/batched/outlier strategies for spatial coverage.

Reprojects equirectangular images to 18 virtual perspective cameras (16 ring cameras across 8 yaw x 2 pitch, plus 2 polar cameras) to run YOLO+SAM masking, because YOLO/SAM fail directly on equirectangular polar distortion.
Dilates masks by roughly 15% coverage to catch loose hair, backpack shadows, and motion blur left by tighter segmentation.

Reduced a 2-minute, 6000-frame 8K walkthrough down to ~40 selected sharp frames, trained via LichtFeld Studio/Nerfstudio, yielding an 8.5 million-splat scene running at 40fps on a budget Android phone.
quotes: the step that actually makes it work

sources.title: 360 Gaussian Splatting Plugins & Tools (2026 Guide) - RadianceFields.com
key_claims: 360 Splat Pro (Ronski, Windows, paid) converts equirectangular video to perspective tiles/cubemap, supports Insta360 .INS and DJI .OSV, includes SAM3 text-prompt masking and SphereSfM alignment; positioned as the explicit Insta360 recommendation.
360 Video Stills Prep Tool (Ronski, Windows, paid) does SAM2 masking and perspective splitting for photogrammetry-style batch workflows.
360 Gaussian (Laskos Virtuals, Windows, free) is described as a free end-to-end trainer from 360 video supporting multiple SfM backends (SphereSfM, COLMAP, Metashape, RealityScan).
Metashape 360 to COLMAP Converter (kotohibi) converts Metashape 360 SfM results into a COLMAP cubemap format with a GUI.
quotes: End-to-end 360° prep pipeline with AI masking and bundled alignment.

sources.title: Convert Insta360 .insp files to equirectangular projection on Ubuntu with FFmpeg (ARJ)
key_claims: Demonstrates that Insta360 .insp files are dual-fisheye JPEGs that can be renamed .jpg and processed directly by ffmpeg's v360 filter.

Uses ffmpeg v360=input=dfisheye:output=e:ih_fov=204:iv_fov=204:w=8000:h=4000 to convert dual-fisheye stills to 8000x4000 equirectangular, with 204 degree FOV found via iterative testing against Insta360 X2 source images.
Notes minor stitching artifacts persisting near the bottom (nadir) edge of the output.
quotes: those cryptic .insp files are just JPEGs

sources.title: Introducing Gaussian Splats for AEC - AEC Magazine
key_claims: Frames gaussian-splat capture for construction/infrastructure as resembling filmmaking rather than laser scanning -- walk with a phone or drone, process into a navigable scene in minutes.
Lists AEC-specific tools integrating splats: Gauzilla Pro, XGRIDS (SLAM + Revit), Autodesk (ReCap/Civil 3D/InfraWorks/Construction Cloud), Bentley iTwin Capture, ESRI ArcGIS Reality, Pix4D.

Explicitly cautions that splats excel at appearance rather than precise geometry and should be anchored to LiDAR/SLAM as the metrical backbone for infrastructure work, not used as a standalone survey deliverable.
quotes: splats excel at appearance rather than precise geometry

sources.title: Insta360 Studio: File Export (Insta360 Online Manual)

Export formats include JPG, MP4, DNG, MOV, and INSV; Equirectangular can be selected as the output projection type for a seamless 360 panorama, with field-of-view/angle adjustment available pre-export for leveling.

sources.title: Insta360, Splatica Partner to Democratize 360-to-3D Gaussian Splatting (Insta360 blog)
key_claims: Insta360 and Splatica announced a partnership turning consumer 360 VIDEO into 3D Gaussian Splats via a cloud pipeline: capture, upload, and receive a production-ready splat in hours with browser/VR viewing and simulation-environment export.

key_claims: Self-supervised framework unprojects 2D pixels into 3D using DUSt3R geometric priors and eliminates Structure-from-Motion entirely.
Reconstruction is >30x faster than SfM+3DGS and improves SSIM from 0.3755 to 0.7624 on sparse-view benchmarks.
Official repo (NVlabs/InstantSplat) supports 3D-GS, 2D-GS, and Mip-Splatting; 33 commits, README does not pin an exact minimum view count.
quotes: Unbounded Sparse-view Pose-free Gaussian Splatting in 40 Seconds

sources.title: FSGS: Real-Time Few-shot View Synthesis using Gaussian Splatting
key_claims: Works with as few as 3 training views using a Gaussian Unpooling process that adds new Gaussians near representative locations to infill vacant areas.
Benchmarked on both indoor (LLFF) and outdoor unbounded (Mip-NeRF360) scenes plus Blender.

sources.title: CoR-GS: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Co-regularization
key_claims: Trains dual Gaussian radiance fields simultaneously and uses co-pruning plus co-regularization between the two fields to improve accuracy of Gaussian primitives under sparse views.

sources.title: Pi-GS: Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with Dense π3 Initialization
key_claims: Uses π3, a reference-free point-cloud estimation network, for dense initialization instead of COLMAP, combined with confidence-aware Pearson-correlation depth loss, normal-consistency loss, and depth-warped pseudo-views generated by circle interpolation between camera pairs.
On Tanks&Temples 3-view PSNR: Pi-GS 22.87 vs Intern-GS 22.67, FSGS 22.31, InstantSplat 22.20, DNGaussian 20.69.
Also evaluated at 12-view and 24-view settings on MipNeRF360 (real outdoor 360-degree scenes).
Code public at github.com/Mango0000/Pi-GS.
quotes: reduces floaters and view inconsistencies

sources.title: Dropping Anchor and Spherical Harmonics for Sparse-view Gaussian Splatting (DropAnSH-GS)
key_claims: Accepted CVPR 2026; identifies that prior random-Gaussian dropout regularizers suffer a 'neighbor compensation effect' where dropped Gaussians get compensated by neighbors, weakening regularization.
Proposes anchor-based dropout that removes whole spatial neighbor clusters at once, plus dropping higher-degree spherical-harmonic coefficients to reduce color-based overfitting.
Official code at github.com/Fangkang515/DropAnSH-GS.
quotes: neighbor compensation effect

sources.title: MS-GS: Multi-Appearance Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
key_claims: Targets in-the-wild photo collections with limited images taken at different times of day or seasons (multi-appearance), built on monocular-depth-estimation geometric priors.
Adds geometry-guided supervision at virtual (interpolated) views at both pixel and feature levels to reduce overfitting.
Accepted at NeurIPS 2025.

sources.title: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild (SaveWildGS)
key_claims: Handles sparse (3/6/9-view) real-world outdoor landmark photos with transient distractors (people, vehicles) via a one-step diffusion reference-guided view refinement, sparsity-aware Gaussian replication (SAGR), and LoRA test-time training with score-distillation loss.
Reports 17.2% PSNR, 10.8% SSIM, 4.0% LPIPS improvement over prior sparse-view baselines on NeRF On-the-go and Photo Tourism (outdoor) plus LLFF.

Explicitly documents two failure modes: difficulty separating static distractors (parked cars, standing pedestrians) from real background, and that overlapped camera perspectives reduce available reference regions, degrading reconstruction.
quotes: overlapped camera perspectives reduce available reference regions

sources.title: ODGS: 3D Scene Reconstruction from Omnidirectional Images with 3D Gaussian Splattings
key_claims: Decomposes each omnidirectional (360) image into six perspective cubemap-face images and rasterizes them directly rather than warping a single equirectangular projection, avoiding the distortion a naive perspective rasterizer produces on 360 images.
Achieves 100x faster optimization/rendering than NeRF-based omnidirectional methods; evaluated on OmniBlender, Ricoh360, OmniPhotos, 360Roam, OmniScenes, 360VO.
Official repo (esw0116/ODGS) is MIT-licensed; last updated 2024-12-26.

key_claims: Feed-forward 3DGS for wide-baseline panorama pairs; performs multi-view matching directly in the spherical domain via a spherical sweep algorithm building a spherical cost volume.

Uses a bi-projection encoder combining equirectangular projection (ERP) and cube-map projection features through multi-view transformers, addressing distortion that naive independent cubemap-face processing introduces.
